_comment: Places where OTHER forges save PromptForge gallery picture names (like 2026-11/abcd1234_0.png). The sweep never deletes a picture whose name appears in any of these files: it copies it into the Library instead. repo is a folder name under PROMPTFORGE_FORGES_ROOT (default: the folder that holds this repo); globs are relative to that repo. CharacterForge is deliberately NOT listed: its linked pictures are independent copies, and its neutral.json and linked records only name the gallery file as provenance.
